name: Tower of Arathor
summary: Boulderfist ogres hold the Tower of Arathor among the ruins of Stromgarde Keep. The spire once served Archmage Trelane in the former mage district, southwest in the keep.

sections.title: A Bastion Overrun
sections.body:
In Stromgarde Keep's mage district, the spire rises above ruins and bears the name of the ancient Empire of Arathor. It once served the realm's sorcerers, most notably Archmage Trelane. He devised a magical defensive grid keyed to enchanted gemstones to guard the sanctum.

After the Third War, the Syndicate and the Boulderfist ogre clan assaulted Stromgarde, and the kingdom fractured. Trelane tried to hold the tower with his arcane wards, but the ogres overwhelmed him. He fled the city for his life and left his most prized arcane artifacts behind. Now the Boulderfist brute Ruul Onestone and his followers hold the spire.

sections.title: Reclaiming the Lost Relics
sections.body:
Even in exile, Trelane would not abandon his life's work. He enlisted his former pupil, Archmage Malin of the Kirin Tor, and an expedition set out to retrieve his phylactery, orb, and ember agate. Working from Refuge Pointe, Malin's agents learned that the ogres had pillaged the stones needed to command the tower's automated defenses.

The agents crafted a replacement enchanted agate and placed it on the pedestals framing the tower's threshold. This awakened conjured water elementals to purge the ogre occupiers, allowing adventurers to recover Trelane's heirlooms.

faq.q: What is the Tower of Arathor?
faq.answer: The Tower of Arathor rises in the southwestern ruins of Stromgarde Keep. Named for the ancient human empire of Arathor, it served as a center of study for the kingdom's mages until invading ogres took it.

faq.q: Who lives in the tower now?
aliases: who is in the tower of arathor
faq.answer: Boulderfist ogres occupy the tower and the surrounding mage district. The ogre mage Ruul Onestone dwells inside the spire with his guards, who have rooted out and guarded the relics left by its former master.

Archmage Trelane was a prominent wizard of Stromgarde who lived and studied in the tower. He created its gemstone-powered wards, then fled into exile after failing to defend the sanctum from the Boulderfist assault.

faq.q: How do the tower's defenses work?
faq.answer: Trelane keyed the tower to awaken when an enchanted agate is placed on the pedestals flanking its entrance. The arcane matrix then conjures hostile water elementals to battle intruders occupying the entrance.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see what became of Stromgarde's arcane enclave and Archmage Trelane's mastery of defensive elemental constructs.
As an Alliance member, you can help Archmage Malin's agents recover Trelane's lost artifacts in contested Stromgarde Keep. That denies potent magical relics to the encroaching Boulderfist clan.
